log.text: Light Screen up on P2's side

decisions.rationale: Leading Charizard and Venusaur provides immediate Sun pressure and Chlorophyll speed control, outspeeding their entire roster. Venusaur's Life Orb Sludge Bomb heavily threatens Primarina and Grimmsnarl, while Charizard-Mega-Y's boosted Heat Wave applies massive spread pressure. Bringing Dragapult and Goodra-Hisui in the back gives fast Infiltrator cleanup that bypasses dual screens and a strong defensive wall against Primarina, Maushold, and Altaria.
decisions.notebook:
Revealed Opponent Sets:
- Gengar-Mega (Timid, Gengarite): Shadow Ball, Sludge Bomb, Destiny Bond, Protect
- Grimmsnarl (Careful, Light Clay, Prankster): Fake Out, Reflect, Light Screen, Spirit Break
- Altaria (Calm, Leftovers, Cloud Nine): Tailwind, Roost, Will-O-Wisp, Moonblast
- Primarina (Modest, Life Orb, Liquid Voice): Hyper Voice, Moonblast, Ice Beam, Protect
- Annihilape (Adamant, Sitrus Berry, Defiant): Rage Fist, Close Combat, Drain Punch, Protect
- Maushold (Jolly, Focus Sash, Friend Guard): Follow Me, Population Bomb, Tidy Up, Protect

Game Plan:
- Charizard + Venusaur lead sets Sun immediately. Chlorophyll Venusaur reaches 264 speed, outspeeding Mega Gengar (max 200) and applying massive pressure with Sludge Bomb/Giga Drain/Earth Power.
- Dragapult with Infiltrator bypasses Light Screen/Reflect and outspeeds all unboosted foes.
- Goodra-Hisui walls special Fairy/Ice attacks from Primarina and Altaria.

decisions.rationale: Grimm+Prim lead screens/FO+LV HV pressure vs Zard/Goodra/Intim FO; Gengar+Alt back for Mega Tag Pult/Goodra and Cloud Nine sun answer. Core matches notebook plan.
decisions.notebook: Opp: ZardY (Modest SolarPower/Drought, HW/SolarBeam/Sands/Protect), Venu (Modest LO Chloro,Sludge/Giga/EarthPower/Protect), Pult (Timid sash Infiltrator, SB/Darts/WoW/Protect), H-Goodra (Modest Lefties ShellArmor, FlashCannon/TB/BodyPress/Protect), Scrafty (Careful Sitrus Intim, FO/Knock/DrainPunch/Taunt), Tink (Jolly MetalCoat MoldBreak, FO/Gigaton/Knock/Feint). My core: Alt Cloud Nine answers sun; Mega Gengar tags Pult; Prim LV pressures Zard/Goodra; Grimm clay screens+FO support. Prefer screens into Intim/FO leads; respect Pult speed/Infiltrator and Tink priority (FO wins prio race vs Grimm). Future: preserve Alt for sun games; Gengar vs Pult/Goodra traps; Prim vs Zard cores. H-Goodra FC fails to break Alt Roost cycles; burn nets residual ~0 vs Lefties; MB chips win long 1v1. Tink Gigaton OHKOes Grimm raw; Reflect lets live. Prim Fairy immune to Darts. Pult sash requires dual hit or follow-up.

decisions.rationale: Protecting Venusaur turn 1 scout/blocks incoming Fake Out or Ice Beam from Primarina while Charizard Mega Evolves to set Sun with Drought. Heat Wave provides strong STAB Sun-boosted spread damage hitting both foes even if one uses Protect. With Sun set, Chlorophyll Venusaur reaches 264 Speed next turn to outspeed and pressure Primarina and Grimmsnarl safely.

selection: Light Screen (your side, including ally Primarina)
decisions.rationale: Prankster Light Screen (clay) before their attacks halves Sludge/SolarBeam/HW; Solar Power sun Beam otherwise can OHKO Prim. Prim then Ice Beams Venu for likely KO/chip while living reduced hits. FO Venu leaves Prim open to sun Beam OHKO; FO Zard lets Chloro Venu Sludge OHKO. Reflect weaker vs both specials.

decisions.rationale: Double-targeting Primarina (81% HP) with Solar Beam and Sludge Bomb aims to KO the primary threat before it can land Ice Beam on Venusaur. Both Chlorophyll Venusaur (264 Speed) and Charizard-Mega-Y (152 Speed) naturally outspeed Primarina (80-112). Grimmsnarl poses minimal offensive threat since Spirit Break is resisted by both active Pokémon.

decisions.rationale: Reflect + Ice Beam Venu: dual screens blunt LO Sludge/EarthPower and Zard HW/Beam while Prim chips Chlorophyll Venu (Screened). Spirit Break weak into both; HV/MB poor into sun core. Protect cedes momentum. Alt/Gengar not needed yet; keep sun answer and tag later.
Altaria Cloud Nine ends sun, neutering Chloro Venu and SolarPower ZardY. Screens up; Roost/WoW/MB pressure both. Gengar better reserved to trap Pult/Goodra later.

Combining Heat Wave and Sludge Bomb targeting Grimmsnarl guarantees a KO on Grimmsnarl (at 61% HP) through Light Screen before it can land a physical hit, as both of our active Pokémon outspeed Grimmsnarl. Heat Wave also delivers spread chip damage onto Altaria.

decisions.rationale: Grimm dies to HW+Sludge double even through LS; switch Gengar (resists Sludge, lives HW via LS). Alt TW for speed vs Pult/Tink while Cloud Nine blanks sun/Chloro/SolarPower. Screens already up.

Venusaur's Earth Power guarantees KO on Gengar (33% HP) through Light Screen (35.6% min damage, 100% accuracy). Charizard Protects to eliminate risk from Destiny Bond or targeted attacks from faster Tailwind-boosted Gengar. If Gengar trades with Venusaur via Destiny Bond, we maintain a 3v2 lead with full HP Charizard, Dragapult (Infiltrator bypasses screens), and Goodra-Hisui which walls Altaria/Grimmsnarl.

decisions.rationale: Goodra-Hisui is the safest switch-in against Altaria and Grimmsnarl. Being Steel/Dragon, Fairy attacks (Spirit Break, Moonblast) deal only neutral damage to it, unlike Dragapult which is weak to Fairy. Goodra-Hisui completely walls both opponents while threatening Grimmsnarl with super-effective Flash Cannon. Dragapult is preserved in reserve with Focus Sash and Infiltrator as a clean-up win condition.

decisions.rationale: Gengar 34% dies to EP/Sands even through LS; Shadow Tag locks both. DB first (outspeeds) forces whoever KOs to faint—free Venu/Zard trade—or they pivot damage to safe Altaria and Gengar lives. Alt WoW Zard (85%) for residual; burn > weak NVE Moonblasts. Protect 1/3 too risky; chips can't KO.
Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Doubling Grimmsnarl with Flash Cannon and Sludge Bomb guarantees its KO through Light Screen even if Fake Out flinches one side. Once Grimmsnarl faints, opponent only has Altaria remaining vs Goodra-Hisui, Venusaur, and Infiltrator Dragapult. Tailwind expires at the end of this turn.

decisions.rationale: Fake Out Goodra to deny action/Protect; WoW Goodra for burn residual vs Lefties ShellArmor. Screens up, TW last turn; pressure tank while Venu Protect-prone. Chip wins long game.

Altaria is the opponent's final remaining Pokémon and only has Moonblast as an attacking move, which both Goodra-Hisui and Venusaur resist. Flash Cannon from Goodra-Hisui and Sludge Bomb from Venusaur will easily chip Altaria down to secure the match victory.

decisions.rationale: Only Altaria left; chip Goodra with Moonblast under screens+burn while Reflect/LS last. WoW already on Goodra; Roost unnecessary at 96%. Tailwind useless alone. Venu resists MB. Force Goodra chip race then hope backline misplays.
Altaria is the opponent's last remaining Pokémon at 2% HP and poisoned. Targeting Altaria with Sludge Bomb and Flash Cannon guarantees the final KO to win Game 3 and the series.
decisions.notebook: Series won 2-1. Revealed Opponent Sets: Gengar-Mega (Timid, Gengarite: Shadow Ball, Sludge Bomb, Destiny Bond, Protect), Grimmsnarl (Careful, Light Clay, Prankster: Fake Out, Reflect, Light Screen, Spirit Break), Altaria (Calm, Leftovers, Cloud Nine: Tailwind, Roost, Will-O-Wisp, Moonblast), Primarina (Modest, Life Orb, Liquid Voice: Hyper Voice, Moonblast, Ice Beam, Protect).

decisions.rationale: Altaria at 2% psn must Roost to survive; any attack or Tailwind leaves it KO'd by residual/poison or foe attacks. Screens still up briefly. Pass on fainted Grimm. Survive to chip or force switches with remaining bench pressure.

reflections.summary: Bringing Mega Charizard Y and Chlorophyll Venusaur alongside Hisuian Goodra provided irresistible offensive pressure against opponent's screens and bulk; even after trading Mega Charizard to Gengar's Destiny Bond, Venusaur's Life Orb Sludge Bomb and Goodra's steel/dragon typing completely dominated the endgame against Grimmsnarl and Altaria.
reflections.adjustment: When facing lower-HP Mega Gengar, utilize double Protects or target the non-Gengar partner to avoid trading Mega Charizard Y into an obvious Destiny Bond.
reflections.notebook: Series won 2-1. Opponent relies on screens/disruption to enable Mega Gengar/Primarina; Sun sweepers (Venusaur/Charizard-Y) with Goodra-Hisui backbone easily outpace and overpower this composition.

reflections.summary: Lost because preview locked Mega Gengar+Altaria Cloud Nine into ZardY/Venu sun, yielding only a Destiny Bond trade for Zard before Venu Sludge and Goodra Flash Cannon dismantled the Grimm screens + Altaria backline; Primarina never impacted.
reflections.adjustment: Change preview: hold Gengarite and lead Primarina+Grimmsnarl (or Prim+Alt) into suspected Zard/Venu to pressure with Hyper Voice before screens, saving Mega Gengar solely for Pult/Goodra traps.
